segments.text:
V. 15.
That it might be fulfilled—that is, whereby was fulfilled. The original Word frequently ſignifies, not the Deſign of an Action, but barely the Conſequence or Event of it. Which was ſpoken of the Lord by the Prophet—on another Occaſion: Out of Egypt have I called my Son—which was now fulfilled as it were anew; Chriſt being in a far higher Senſe the Son of GOD, than Iſrael, of whom the Words were originally ſpoken.
